note: All events Best of 9, DH on, 1970 RE, 1971 Dodger Stadium, Variants Cap 11 (not including Live and PDs); first sim ET. 'Low <tier>' is the tier's lower half as a ceiling with no floor (Low Iron 40-49, Low Bronze 40-64, ... Low Diamond 40-94), per tierWindowFromName; 'Gold Floor' is 80 and up. Variant cap and Live-only are set in `rules` because parseRestrictions doesn't read them. Ranges confirmed by L.J. 2026-10-01: Bronze 40-64, Silver 40-74, Gold 40-84, Diamond 40-94, Open 40-103, Cap 85-103 (not the Gold Floor of 80 first read).
